# dsh-attention-notify
English | 中文
Native browser notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The plugin observes the existing DSH sessio
n-list feed and notifies for:

- conversation and subtask completion
- approval requests
- questions awaiting an answer
- plans awa

iting review
- completed, failed, or killed background jobs
It remains event-driven while the page is hidden; there is no visibility-gated polling. Clicking a n
otification focuses the browser and opens the matching session.
The first job list for each session establishes a baseline, so opening or reconnecting a session doe
s not replay old job completions. Later terminal transitions, including jobs that finish between sna
pshots, still notify.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web`, refresh the page, then open **Settings → General → Task notifications** and choos
e **Enable notifications**. A successful permission grant sends one test notification. Already-enabl
ed browsers show a **Send test notification** action. Dismissed or blocked permission requests leave
visible site-settings guidance in the same row.
The notification control lives in Settings and no longer occupies the sidebar footer. Existing brows
er permission is preserved; notifications continue while Settings is closed. To turn off browser not
ifications, change the permission in your browser's site settings.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH Web after removing the plugin.
## Privacy and limits

- Zero runtime dependencies. No server, shell execution, external requests, or telemetry.
- Notifica
tion text contains the DSH session title or background-job label and may be visible in lock-screen p

reviews.
- The DSH page must remain open. A browser or operating system that suspends or discards th

e page also suspends a page-only plugin.
- The control uses DSH's native General settings layout. Ve
ry narrow windows currently inherit its fixed two-column layout.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`npm test` builds the browser bundle before running the built-in Node test runner.
